name: mcal_create_calendar
description: Create a new calendar for the account. `name` is the human label; `timezone` is a REQUIRED IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York) — every calendar has one, and it is the locale used to interpret the user's times and resolve day queries. If the user hasn't told you their timezone, ASK before creating — never guess. `slug` is an optional URL-safe id (lowercase letters, digits, dashes) — if omitted it is derived from the name. Slugs must be unique within the account (409 if taken). Requires the write scope (403 otherwise). Returns the created calendar including its `slug` and `timezone`.

timezone.description: REQUIRED IANA timezone, e.g. 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Tokyo'. Ask the user if you don't know it — do not guess.

slug.description: Optional URL-safe id (lowercase, digits, dashes). Derived from name if omitted.
